parsed.why: Enforced cross-dressing criminal offence targeting gender expression directly; no document alignment possible; religious penal code with stoning (moratorium, revocable) and no assurance foreigners exempt. State is perpetrator; outed visitor faces prosecution under morality regime.

No traveler-facing restrictions; criminalised hate speech/hate crime covering gender identity, conversion-practices ban, civil unions, non-binary recognition in one part. Deductions for inconsistent enforcement, clergy incitement drawing no action, and gender identity absent from equal-treatment grounds.

Decriminalised but no general protections, no gender recognition, documented rape/assaults and official insensitivity with thin recourse, plus a legal analysis that a mismatched passport could ground a charge. Offsetting: police-escorted Pride, LGBTI org working with police nationwide.

Decriminalised 2022 with a court reading gender identity into constitutional equality; no traveler-facing exposure documented, single dated assault only. Deductions for no statutory protection regime, prior official resistance, and a thin record leaving screening and custody practice open.

Criminalised sodomy broadened to mere same-sex contact and kissing; documented state campaigns using intelligence services to beat, arrest, rape and kill; censorship weaponised against LGBTQ people; no gender-marker change or protections. Mitigating: health-ministry care mandate, strong legal-aid org, bathroom arrest defeated.
